query:
query FindTableWidgetViews($viewTypes: [ViewType!]) {
  getViews(viewTypes: $viewTypes) {
    ...ViewFragment
    __typename
  }
}

fragment ViewFieldFragment on ViewField {
  id
  fieldMetadataId
  viewId
  isVisible
  position
  size
  aggregateOperation
  viewFieldGroupId
  isActive
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  deletedAt
  __typename
}

fragment ViewFieldGroupFragment on ViewFieldGroup {
  id
  name
  position
  isVisible
  viewId
  isActive
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  deletedAt
  viewFields {
    ...ViewFieldFragment
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment ViewFilterFragment on ViewFilter {
  id
  fieldMetadataId
  operand
  value
  viewFilterGroupId
  positionInViewFilterGroup
  subFieldName
  relationTargetFieldMetadataId
  viewId
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  deletedAt
  __typename
}

fragment ViewFilterGroupFragment on ViewFilterGroup {
  id
  parentViewFilterGroupId
  logicalOperator
  positionInViewFilterGroup
  viewId
  __typename
}

fragment ViewSortFragment on ViewSort {
  id
  fieldMetadataId
  direction
  subFieldName
  viewId
  createdAt
  deletedAt
  updatedAt
  __typename
}

fragment ViewGroupFragment on ViewGroup {
  id
  isVisible
  fieldValue
  position
  viewId
  createdAt
  updatedAt
  deletedAt
  __typename
}

fragment ViewFragment on View {
  id
  name
  objectMetadataId
  type
  key
  icon
  position
  isCompact
  kanbanAggregateOperation
  kanbanAggregateOperationFieldMetadataId
  mainGroupByFieldMetadataId
  shouldHideEmptyGroups
  kanbanColumnWidth
  groupLoadLimit
  anyFieldFilterValue
  calendarFieldMetadataId
  calendarEndFieldMetadataId
  calendarLayout
  visibility
  createdByUserWorkspaceId
  applicationId
  universalIdentifier
  isActive
  viewFields {
    ...ViewFieldFragment
    __typename
  }
  viewFieldGroups {
    ...ViewFieldGroupFragment
    __typename
  }
  viewFilters {
    ...ViewFilterFragment
    __typename
  }
  viewFilterGroups {
    ...ViewFilterGroupFragment
    __typename
  }
  viewSorts {
    ...ViewSortFragment
    __typename
  }
  viewGroups {
    ...ViewGroupFragment
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}
